about: Device.Address (types/0x0001-device.md §2.5; 06-cykl-zycia-urzadzenia.md §4.2): readable, and writable to re-address the node — the new address goes to the store BEFORE the reply, the reply still leaves from the OLD address, everything after it from the new one. Only node addresses 0x001-0x7FD: 0x000 is forgetting the address, which is FactoryReset's job, 0x7FE is the hub and 0x7FF broadcast. Writing the address the node already has changes nothing. Missing from the C library until 2026-10-13: a read was UNSUPPORTED_ELEMENT and a write READ_ONLY.

steps.note: Address = 0x043: stored first, answered from the old address
the old address is not ours any more
the same address: OK, nothing changes
reports and replies go out from the new address
